subject.name: Mathematics
subject.examPattern: Cambridge Lower Secondary Checkpoint (externally set, taken in school on timetabled date – Mar/May/Oct series). Paper 1 Non-calculator 1 h + Paper 2 Calculator 1 h, ~50 marks each (UNVERIFIED), ~20–25 multi-part questions each. Reported on 0–50 scale + performance band.

subtopics.name: Standard form for large and small numbers
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Multiplying and dividing by powers of 10 (Stage 8); place value of decimals

subtopics.name: Laws of indices including zero and negative indices
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Index notation and positive integer indices (Stage 8)

subtopics.name: Estimating and calculating with standard form

subtopics.name: Substituting into expressions and formulae

subtopics.name: Constructing expressions and formulae

subtopics.name: Expanding the product of two linear expressions

subtopics.name: Factorising by taking out common factors
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Highest common factor of numbers (Stage 7-8); expanding brackets
